points.description: States 'Consensus' (agreement among stakeholders/members) as a principle.
points.partial_credit: Idea of agreement or general acceptance stated vaguely

points.description: States 'Industry-wide applicability' (applicable across all industries/sectors) as a principle.
points.partial_credit: Says widely applicable or global use without the industry-wide idea

points.description: States 'Voluntary nature' (standards are voluntary, not mandatory) as a principle.

rubric.notes: One point per principle, marks shared equally; total 2. Full marks for all three (consensus, industry-wide applicability, voluntary nature), clear synonyms accepted. Round the total to the nearest whole mark (0, 1 or 2): about one correct item gives 1 only if two are partly right, two correct gives 1 or 2 by the teacher's judgement, all three gives 2. Wrong or unrelated items earn nothing but do not remove marks for correct ones.
